CHAOS-9676: in oracle_cases.json the case impact_summary/manyScopes holds the Go resolver's answer for aiAssistedPrs and aiAssistedPrRatio, not the Python resolver's. The Python resolvers were deleted (#2794) and their summary added the stored group-wide ai_assisted_prs column over every bucket row, which counts a group once per emitted bucket row; the summary now takes each count from its own bucket's prs_total (aiAssistedPrs 11 -> 90 and aiAssistedPrRatio 0.0759 -> 0.6207 on this synthetic fixture, whose stored ai_assisted_prs column is not the bucket's pull-request count). Every other value in the file is unchanged. The change was written by the script recorded in the PR (the case's Go answer, field by field), not typed.

CHAOS-14101: in oracle_cases.json the case review_load/teamNoRepos holds the Go resolver's answer for reviewerConcentration and missingStates, not the Python resolver's. The Python resolver scoped the reviewer concentration by user_metrics_daily.team_id, a person's membership label; a team scope is the repositories the team owns (team-attribution.md, "The AI analytics team scope uses repository ownership"), and this team owns none, so the concentration is no data (reviewerCount 2 -> 0, dataAvailable true -> false, plus the reviewer_concentration missing state). Every other value in the file is unchanged. The change was written by a script recorded in the PR, not typed.

CHAOS-14677: in oracle_b_cases.json the cases overview/teamCatalogueFails and prs/teamCatalogueFails hold the Go resolver's behavior, not the Python resolver's, a declared divergence. With a team scope whose team catalogue / ownership read fails, the Python resolvers ran the org-wide read: aiAttributionOverview served the org mix (totalAttributed 10, dataAvailable true) and aiAttributedPrs read its page with no repository narrowing (calls.prs recorded). A team-scoped ask never serves org-wide rows: the Go resolvers follow the sibling rule of the other team-scoped AI reads (scope.go, teamRepos) and answer no data with no read (overview: mix [], totalAttributed 0, dataAvailable false; both cases: calls {}). Every other value in the file is unchanged. The change was written by a script recorded in the PR, not typed.
